pages.text: $(l)Lift-off$()$(br)Rockets are built at the $(item)NASA Workbench$() (it runs on a Plutonium Pellet). Refine oil into $(item)rocket fuel$(). Wear all four pieces of a $(item)space suit$() and keep its oxygen topped up.
$(l)The worlds$()$(br)Tier 1 reaches the Moon ($(item)desh$()), tier 2 Mars ($(item)ostrum$()), tier 3 Venus and Mercury ($(item)calorite$()), tier 4 Glacio. Venus needs the netherite space suit.
Each world's guardian drops a $(item)sigil$(). With that world's metal it becomes a $(item)planet core$(). You need all five.

$(l)The Heart$()$(br)Build a base on any planet. The $(item)Emblem of the Ages$(), the five cores, an $(item)Antimatter Pellet$() and two ultimate control circuits forge the $(item)Heart of the Ages$().
